# Evaluación determinística de la amenaza sísmica (DSHA) {#sec-mce}

## Resumen ejecutivo {#sec-dsha_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/dsha.summary.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/dsha.results.es.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-dsha-summary-site",
    context = "resumen DSHA"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/dsha.results.es.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-results",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-dsha-results-site",
    context = "resultados DSHA"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/UHS.compare.ES.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-compare",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),

    context = "comparación DSHA"
  )
}
rm(i, SiteTable)
```
